personal.bio1: Hi, I'm Ömer — a Software Engineering graduate from Istanbul Aydın University, where I earned my degree studying entirely in English. Throughout my degree I built real products: web applications, mobile apps, AI-assisted tools, games and IoT systems — getting hands-on with the full development process from day one, not just in theory.
personal.bio2: My experience spans frontend development, backend services, database design, and API integration. During my internship at Cabitas I worked directly on production systems — contributing to database architecture, maintaining application workflows, and collaborating in a real engineering team. I bring both a builder's instinct and an engineer's eye for quality to everything I ship.
personal.bio3: Beyond core development, I also take on digital and visual work — landing pages, branding, and catalogs. I like owning a project end-to-end, whether it's a web platform, a mobile app, or a complete digital presence — one person, full ownership, no handoffs.
personal.seoDescription: Software Engineer specializing in modern web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile development and AI-powered software.
